overview_description.description: Recurrency helps wholesale distributors and B2B retailers automate and optimize the pricing and sales processes. It automates sales, purchasing, and pricing workflows in the existing ERP to drive organic revenue and margin growth, boost team productivity, and enhance customer experience. The platform provides distributors with the software tools they need to compete more effectively in a disrupted, always-on, winner-take-all business environment.

about_short_description.short_description: Recurrency is an ERP automation platform.

product.name: Recurrency Purchasing
product.description: Automates purchasing decisions by generating optimized purchase orders and managing inventory replenishment based on data-driven forecasts and vendor lead times.

product.name: Recurrency Demand Forecasting
product.description: Provides data-driven demand forecasts up to 18 months ahead with adjustable parameters and demand pattern classification to support inventory planning.

product.name: Recurrency Demand Planning
product.description: Optimizes inventory min/max levels and lead times dynamically to prevent stockouts and reduce excess inventory across complex supply chains.

product.name: Recurrency Inventory Reporting (Free)
product.description: Offers real-time inventory visibility and KPI tracking with flexible drilldowns and easy setup, enabling users to monitor inventory performance without complex configuration.

product.name: Recurrency Sales
product.description: Supports sales teams with AI-driven reorder predictions, dynamic pricing, and automated upselling to enhance order size and customer retention.
